title: Platform ops tactical lane notes — Apr 05 2027
content:
Purpose: quick tactical notes from this week's platform ops rotation. These are working notes intended for on-call handoffs, immediate follow-ups, and short-term tactical planning. Not a formal retrospective; file to PLTFM drive for context.

Date: 2027-04-05
Attendees: Maya Chen (owner), Rafael Gomez, Priya Natarajan, Evan Park, Zoë Laurent.

Highlights
- Performed a controlled leader-election stress test in sandbox; observed ~150ms election latency spike under synthetic partition. Good baseline for next non-prod run.
- Routing fallthrough policy V2 schema merged to staging (PR #2881). Will exercise in canary next week.
- Quota shaper introduced a short tail-edge bug causing 2% of requests to be double-counted during burst drains; hotfix deployed to staging.

Metrics snapshot (last 7d)
- Control plane API p95: 210ms (target <200ms) — slight degradation coinciding with leader election spikes.
- Routing decision latency median: 12ms; p99: 62ms.
- Auth token refresh error rate: 0.12% (baseline 0.05%) — small uptick after KMS key rotation last month.
- Quota enforcement rejects: 0.45% of requests; majority are from a recurring high-throughput test client.

Control plane notes
- What we did: ran leader-election flakiness probe across 6 nodes; captured race conditions where ephemeral locks expired earlier than expected under heavy GC pressure.
- Action: Rafael to instrument lock TTL jitter and add an adaptive backoff (LIN-4721). ETA: 2027-04-12.
- Open PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2876 (lock jitter), #2881 (controlplane routing hooks).
- Risk: if GC load pattern hits prod during peak, leader turnover could transiently increase API latencies by 2–3x. Mitigation: promote staggered GC configs for control-plane pods in Dedicated regions.

Routing lane
- Deployed routing fallthrough v2 schema to staging; schema adds explicit model-variant priorities and capacity hints.
- Canary plan: route 1% of traffic to V2 in us-west-2 for 48h, with automatic rollback on 5xx>0.5% or latency p95 increase >20%.
- Task: Priya to wire a canary watch in the console that surfaces model-variant capacity projections and alerts on asymmetry. Slack alert channel: #pltfm-routing-canary.

Auth lane
- Observed small spike in token refresh errors after last KMS rotation window; root cause likely transient key caching mismatch between token-issuer and auth-proxy.
- Short-term: evict proxy cache on next maintenance window (Evan). Long-term: add v2 of key-id pinning to the proxy to avoid race windows (design doc in Confluence).
- Note: rotate schedule changed — ensure ops playbook updated (Confluence link above).

Quotas lane
- The quota shaper bug: during burst drain if the shaping window rolled early, counters were incremented twice for a small subset of shards. Hotfix in staging; prod rollout gated on smoke test results.
- Follow-up: add idempotency key for quota increments to reduce surface area for double-counts. Owner: Zoë. ETA: 2027-04-15.
- Capacity planning: we still need to finalize burst buffer knobs for Dedicated customers. Draft spreadsheet in team drive; invite platform PMs to review next Tuesday.

Incidents / recent blips
- 2027-04-03 02:14 UTC: minor routing mismatch in eu-central due to stale region mapping; affected 0.6% of requests for ~4 minutes. Root cause: cache TTL misconfiguration in cross-region mapping service. Remedied by TTL reduction and forced refresh. Postmortem scheduled for 2027-04-09.

Action items (short list)
- Rafael: implement lock TTL jitter and add metrics (LIN-4721). Due 2027-04-12.
- Priya: console canary watch + alerting for routing v2. Due 2027-04-11.
- Evan: schedule proxy cache eviction and validate token refresh flows in staging. Due 2027-04-07.
- Zoë: quota idempotency keys design + spike test. Due 2027-04-15.
- Maya: coordinate Dedicated customer burst buffer knobs doc and send invite to PMs. Due 2027-04-09.

Blockers
- Need final sign-off from security on KMS key rotation avoidance window before we do the proxy evict in prod. Security review requested (PRIORITY: high).
- Limited Dedicated staging capacity for running full routing canary traffic; working with infra to allocate temporary nodes.

Decisions made
- Routing fallthrough V2 will use staged canary 1% -> 5% -> 20% progression guarded by automated rollback rules.
- Quota hotfix path: deploy to 1/3 of quota-enforcement fleet, run 24h smoke window, then expand.

Notes to self / TODOs
- Add a small section in the ops runbook for leader-election probe and what to look for in traces.
- Reconcile alert thresholds: p95 control-plane API -> lower threshold to 180ms for staging to catch regressions earlier.

Appendix (useful links)
- Design notes: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PLTFM/Quota+Shaper+Design+Notes
- Canary PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2881
- Linear tickets: LIN-4721 (lock jitter), LIN-4788 (quota idempotency)

Next meeting / handoff
- Next tactical sync: 2027-04-12, 10:30 PT. Handoff to Rafael for rotations that week.

End of notes.
